text: {"edits": [], "notes": "No edits proposed. The only Pydantic v1 API in scripts/strip_user.py was `User.parse_obj(...)` (finding scripts/strip_user.py:26:deprecated-method). The current file already uses `User.model_validate(...)`, which matches the migration guide table (`parse_obj()` -> `model_validate()`), so that finding is resolved and should not be reverted. No other v1 APIs remain in the file (no `.dict()`, `.json()`, `.copy()`, `.construct()`, `parse_raw`, `parse_file`, `from_orm`, `__fields__`, `update_forward_refs`, or `validator`/`root_validator` usage), and the imports (`OkdataPermission`, `User`, `UserType`, `resource_server_from_env`) are all still used.\n\nThe reported test failure is `tests.dataplatform_keycloak.test_teams_client_proxy::test_teams_client_no_connection_proxy`, which raises `KeycloakConnectionError` with `Connection refused` on localhost:35789. That is a network/environment problem (a Keycloak mock or server is not listening on that port), not a Pydantic API issue, and it does not touch scripts/strip_user.py at all. Changing this file cannot fix it, so I did not edit the file to chase it. The failing test should be checked for its test-harness setup (for example, whether the test expects a local Keycloak service to be running or a fixture that starts it)."}
